The code walkthrough provided usage instructions. Replication achieved 100% numerical match with cached results (32/32 test cases).

Required packages (torch, nnsight, transformers, matplotlib) installed via pip without conflicts. Pre-computed head importance scores were available in cache/causal_scores/. All datasets (word2vec, fvs tasks) were present in the data/ directory. CUDA/GPU support worked correctly on NVIDIA H100 NVL.

The replication achieved exactly 0.0000 average difference from cached results across all 32 test cases. The methodology involves deterministic operations (OV matrix computation from fixed model weights, cosine similarity for nearest neighbor). No variance was observed.
